result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.set_node_attrs()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Set attribute values for one or more nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L7011-L7151){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.set_node_attrs(node_attr, values, nodes=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Updates a specific attribute on nodes. Can set the same value for all nodes, or provide different values via a list or dictionary. Creates the attribute if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [node_attr]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The name of the attribute to set. [values]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any | list[Any] | dict[int, Any]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The value(s) to set. Can be a (1) single value, applied to all specified nodes, (2) a list, must match length of nodes (paired by position), and (3) a dict, maps node IDs to values (only sets specified nodes). [nodes]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[int | str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional list of node IDs (int) or labels (str) to update. If `None`, updates all nodes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If values is a list and length doesn't match nodes length. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Set same value for specific nodes using node IDs: ::: {#35978b1d .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") ) a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") b_id = graph.get_id_from_label("B") graph.set_node_attrs("color", "blue", nodes=[a_id, b_id]) colors = graph.get_node_attrs("color") # Returns dict mapping node IDs to 'blue': {1: 'blue', 2: 'blue'} ``` ::: Can also use labels: ::: {#81cad095 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") ) graph.set_node_attrs("color", "red", nodes=["A", "B"]) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 0 Directed : False Density : 0.00 Average degree (min, max) : 0.00 (0, 0) Connected : False Number of connected components : 3 Tree : False Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: Set same value for all nodes: ::: {#3a6be4da .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") ) graph.set_node_attrs("status", "active") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 0 Directed : False Density : 0.00 Average degree (min, max) : 0.00 (0, 0) Connected : False Number of connected components : 3 Tree : False Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: Set different values using a list: ::: {#5a1bd989 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") ) node_ids = [graph.get_id_from_label(l) for l in ["A", "B", "C"]] graph.set_node_attrs("score", [100, 85, 92], nodes=node_ids) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 0 Directed : False Density : 0.00 Average degree (min, max) : 0.00 (0, 0) Connected : False Number of connected components : 3 Tree : False Bipartite : True ``` ::: ::: Set different values using a dictionary: ::: {#75d995ef .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") ) id_map = {graph.get_id_from_label("A"): "primary", graph.get_id_from_label("B"): "secondary", graph.get_id_from_label("C"): "primary"} graph.set_node_attrs("category", id_map) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=5} ``` Number of nodes : 3 Number of edges : 0 Directed : False Density : 0.00 Average degree (min, max) : 0.00 (0, 0) Connected : False Number of connected components : 3 Tree : False Bipartite : True ``` ::: :::
